title: Freeman Dyson on IDA advisory board
place_text: Institute for Defense Analysis, Center for Communications Research, New Jersey

tellings.quote: where I worked a member of The Advisory board for that place that I worked Freeman Dyson was on it

plain: A former intelligence contractor named Bob Maguire says that the physicist Freeman Dyson sat on the advisory board of the place where he worked, the Center for Communications Research in New Jersey, part of the Institute for Defense Analyses, a research group that works for the US government. Maguire tells this as a fact of his own workplace. He brings it up to show how well-known the minds around that work were.
